about: Held-out intent probe v3. Written on 2026-10-25 and committed BEFORE the rule change that follows the v2 false deletion, so git history shows it was not tuned on. It covers the category of that error (retracting or reversing an earlier request) in seven languages and in both directions, plus every other request category and some deliberately hard cases (removing a single field, a reopened account, injected instructions). Scored once after the change; not used for tuning.
